metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a short rehearsal, the wet sheets, the carrier, Egeon, and five lines of Theseus.

yesterday: Fourteen shillings, unbound. Nothing promised for Whitsun. An error acquires company. Theseus was the next sheet. The sheets went flat.
Tenpence. Twopence, twopence, and sixpence. The thimble is marked for the Monday after Rogation Sunday.
Hamnet's water-wheel, in his own line. Judith disputes the name, and has a second ballad. Susanna will tell you the fault herself.
You walked north from the Bell and spoke Egeon in Errors. Five lines of Theseus stayed.
